name: Becas Santander / Santander Open Academy (umbrella programme — scholarships delivered per call and per partner university)
funder: Banco Santander (Santander Universidades / Santander Open Academy)
amount_detail: NO SINGLE AMOUNT — this is a catalogue, not one scholarship. Each call sets its own award. "More than 900 programmes"; "+1,000 universities, institutions and organisations collaborating in 13 countries". Most catalogue items are FREE ONLINE COURSES (language, skills, tech) worth no cash to a master's student; the cash-bearing lines are the Academic Mobility, Research, Professional Internships and Financial Assistance categories, which are published per partner university.
covers: Four declared scholarship categories: "Financial Assistance — Scholarships for financial assistance to support undergraduate studies and university access for those in need. Academic Mobility — Scholarships for national and international mobility to study at another academic institution. Research — Scholarships for students and faculty to support research in a specific program or project. Professional Internships — Scholarships to facilitate access to the job market through professional internships."
eligibility_verbatim: Platform-level: "To sign up and start learning, you just need to be over 16 years old. We believe in your potential and want to help you succeed, whether or not you're a bank customer." / "Anyone can register on Santander Open Academy — you do not need to be a Banco Santander customer." / FAQ, 'Can I access from any country?': "Yes, Santander Open Academy is globally accessible. You only need an internet connection to access it from Europe, the Americas or any other region. There are no specific residency requirements for direct-access courses. There may be geographic specifications for programmes with limited places and scholarships. Always check the Legal Terms of each programme." / "Who can apply for Santander Open Academy scholarships? The scholarships are aimed at a wide variety of profiles, from university students to professionals. Each call may have specific requirements, so review the eligibility criteria."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: There is NO nationality bar at the umbrella level — the bar is institutional affiliation. FAQ, 'What happens if my university does not appear on the list?': "Some programmes are specifically aimed at students from certain universities. If this is the case and your university is not among the participants, you will not be able to apply for that particular programme. But don't worry — you are sure to find other programmes you can participate in!" And: "Partner institution programmes — The universities and institutions we work with also publish their own programmes for their academic communities." Plus the geographic caveat: "There may be geographic specifications for programmes with limited places and scholarships."
deadline_2027_intake: NOT APPLICABLE at umbrella level — deadlines are per call, rolling throughout the year, published on app.santanderopenacademy.com. NOT FOUND for any specific Spain master's call for the Sept-2027 intake.
notes: UMBRELLA MECHANICS — the answer to 'can a non-EU applicant hold one' is YES IN PRINCIPLE, NO IN PRACTICE UNTIL ADMITTED. Nationality is not a filter: registration is open worldwide to anyone over 16, no Santander banking relationship needed, and there is no citizenship clause anywhere in the platform terms. The real gate is that money-bearing Santander scholarships are issued THROUGH a partner university to ITS OWN academic community — you must already be a student of (or admitted to) a participating institution before you can even see the call in your account, and if your university is not on the list the application form will not open. CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS CANDIDATE: a Santander scholarship is NOT an admission-stage funding route and cannot be counted on when choosing where to apply. It becomes reachable only AFTER securing a place at a Spanish partner university, and then only for whatever that university happens to publish (typically mobility grants, internship grants, or small tuition-assistance awards — rarely full master's tuition). Treat it as a possible top-up in year 1, never as the plan. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: once a target university is chosen, check that university's own Santander Universidades page for the specific call and its Legal Terms (Términos legales), which is where any nationality/residency clause would live. CAVEAT ON COVERAGE: I could not enumerate the live call catalogue — app.santanderopenacademy.com/en/program/search is a JavaScript SPA that returns only an empty shell to automated fetching, and its JS bundle is served 403, so no specific Spain-master's call could be inspected. The WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted before I could search for one. This is a genuine gap, not a finding of absence.

exclusion_clause_verbatim: "ser natural y vecino de Cantabria o haber residido en la comunidad como mínimo los tres años inmediatamente anteriores a la solicitud de la beca; no ser mayor de 25 años; no estar en posesión del título de licenciado o grado". Three independent bars for this candidate: Cantabria residency (3 years minimum, proven by empadronamiento), and — decisively — the scheme funds people who do NOT yet hold a degree, i.e. undergraduates, so a master's applicant is out of scope by definition.
deadline_2027_intake: Becas para Estudios Universitarios 2026-2027: applications closed 31 July 2026; results published September 2026. NOT APPLICABLE to a master's applicant.
notes: CLEAN DOCUMENTED NO — Fundación Botín runs NO postgraduate scholarship in any technical field. Its full current becas portfolio is: Becas para Estudios Universitarios (undergraduate, Cantabria-only), Becas de Arte (visual arts — genuinely open to "artistas de cualquier nacionalidad", but visual-arts practice, not a master's), Beca de Comisariado de Exposiciones y Gestión de Museos (curatorial studies abroad), and non-academic Talleres de Arte. The Fundación's science activity is technology transfer (Mind the Gap), not student funding. Note in passing that the Becas de Arte line IS nationality-blind — "artistas de cualquier nacionalidad pueden concurrir a esta convocatoria" — which is the exception that proves how rare open nationality is among Spanish foundations; it is however irrelevant to path codes A/B/C/AA/AB/AC/X/P/S. Contact: becas@fundacionbotin.org, Pedrueca 1, 39003 Santander, +34 942 226 072.

name: Oportunidad al Talento — Becas de Máster y Posgrado (and the wider Fundación ONCE becas portfolio)
amount_detail: NOT FOUND for the Máster/Posgrado line — the convocatoria is served from a Salesforce Experience Cloud single-page app (ayudasybecas.fundaciononce.es) that returns only a loading shell to automated fetching. For comparison, the sibling 'Fundación ONCE-Investiga' line publishes "becas por un importe de 18.000 euros anuales para doctorado y 30.000 euros para investigación, cofinanciados por el Fondo Social Europeo", and the oposiciones line "ayudas económicas de hasta 5.000 euros al año".
covers: Oportunidad al Talento covers: Becas de Movilidad Internacional, Máster y Posgrado, Doctorado, Investigación, Formación Profesional, and Estudio y Deporte.
eligibility_verbatim: "Con los programas de Becas de la Fundación ONCE queremos apostar por la educación y el acceso al conocimiento de los jóvenes con discapacidad" — every line in the portfolio is addressed to "personas con discapacidad" (e.g. Fundación ONCE-Investiga "impulsa la inclusión de personas con discapacidad en la ciencia"; the oposiciones aid is "para personas con discapacidad con titulación universitaria"; Programa Radia is for "mujeres con discapacidad").
exclusion_clause_verbatim: The binding condition across the whole Fundación ONCE becas portfolio is certified disability. The exact threshold and the issuing-authority rule (Spanish disability certificate) could NOT be read from the primary convocatoria — see notes. Do NOT assume a percentage figure; it is NOT FOUND here.
deadline_2027_intake: "Las solicitudes para las becas máster, movilidad internacional, formación profesional y estudios y deporte, deberán ser dirigidas a la Fundación ONCE desde la publicación de la convocatoria hasta el 30 de septiembre. Las solicitudes para las becas de doctorado e investigación […] hasta el 10 de octubre." (annual pattern, from the funder's own becas portal). The specific 2027 call dates are NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25.
notes: NO ON A NON-NATIONALITY GROUND. Fundación ONCE's scholarships are a disability-inclusion instrument, not a general international scholarship: the whole portfolio (Oportunidad al Talento, ONCE-Investiga, Becas por Talento Digital, Programa Radia, Becas a la Excelencia, Prácticas ONCE-CRUE, ayudas para oposiciones) is addressed exclusively to people with a recognised disability. The candidate profile in the brief records no disability, so this route is closed. IF that assumption is wrong, this becomes a real route worth a human visit — the Máster y Posgrado line is exactly the right level, and the portfolio has no nationality clause visible at portal level. GAP TO CLOSE BY HUMAN: the convocatoria bases live inside a Salesforce SPA that cannot be read by any automated fetch, so I could NOT verify (a) the disability percentage threshold, (b) whether the disability certificate must be issued by a Spanish administration, (c) whether Spanish residency or a Spanish university enrolment is required, or (d) the euro amounts for the master's line. The neighbouring www.oportunidadaltalento.org domain does not resolve/connect from this environment at all (502 CONNECT tunnel / DNS failure). All four of those unknowns must be checked in a normal browser before this record is relied on.
